headline: US Treasuries Rally as Mideast Tensions and Tech Pullback Spur Safe-Haven Demand
summary: U.S. government bonds surged as heightened Middle East conflict and an artificial intelligence stock sell-off drove investors toward safe-haven assets. U.S. stock futures held steady after the Nasdaq index registered its steepest drop since June.
why: U.S. Treasuries are the primary global benchmark for risk-free assets. Sudden flight-to-safety flows depress yields and impact global asset pricing.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Note
impacts.why: Yields fell as bond prices surged on safe-haven buying.

why_moved: Treasuries gained as geopolitical risks in the Middle East and a sharp pullback in technology shares drove capital into government debt.
